discrepancy_notes: Model year: jeep.com's main Grand Cherokee page currently defaults to 2026, but Edmunds, multiple dealer groups (Luther, McGovern, Huffines), and real VINs all show 2027 Limited Reserve units genuinely in stock/for sale as of Oct 2026, so 2027 is reported per task instructions. Base MSRP conflicts across sources and is NOT resolved: jeep.com Build & Price (2026) showed Limited Reserve 4WD at $51,915; Edmunds' 2027 trim list shows $52,555 (a ~$640 bump consistent with the 2026->2027 increase seen on every other trim, e.g. Limited $44,320->$44,960); cars.com's 2027 comparison table shows Limited Reserve 4x4 at $47,130 -- identical to its own Limited 4x4 figure, which looks like a cars.com data error (duplicating the Limited price) rather than a real price, but this was not independently confirmed; KBB's comparison-table price of $54,550 may be a 'fair purchase price' or dealer-average figure rather than MSRP -- the page did not label it. None of these were picked as authoritative; all four are preserved here rather than guessed between. Exterior color palette also conflicts: cars.com's Limited/Limited Reserve comparison lists Bright White, Electric Blue Pearl, Black, Ghost Ruby Red Pearl, Fathom Blue Pearl, Ceramic Grey Clearcoat, Copper Shino Metallic Clearcoat (7 colors); Edmunds' trims page lists Sting-Gray Clear Coat, High Gloss Black, Bright White Clear Coat, Steel Blue, Fathom Blue Pearl Coat, Copper Shino Metallic Clear Coat (6 colors, 3 overlapping). The union of both lists is recorded here as 'Standard' availability since neither source flagged any as extra-cost, but this is a combined list, not an independently per-trim-confirmed one -- see confidence_notes.
confidence_notes: HIGH-CONFIDENCE items (consistent across jeep.com, Edmunds, cars.com, KBB, and the real dealer window sticker): trim exists and is 4WD-only (no 4x2 Limited Reserve found anywhere); engine is the 2.0L Hurricane4 turbo I4 (324 hp/332 lb-ft, 8-speed auto) with no alternate engine option; seats 5. LOWER-CONFIDENCE / UNCONFIRMED items, left blank or flagged rather than guessed: (1) Exterior color list is a union of two partially-conflicting sources (see discrepancy_notes) and whether any color carries a surcharge on this specific trim was not stated by either source, so all are marked Standard/no-charge by default rather than guessed at a specific upcharge -- verify against jeep.com's live configurator before use. (2) Only ONE real-world build (the McGovern window sticker) was found with full equipment detail; its exact wheel (20-inch machined-face black aluminum) and interior color (Global Black) are recorded as that build's values, not independently confirmed as the trim's only standard options -- other Limited Reserve units may differ. (3) Whether front-seat heating is standard-equipment or ships only via the Quick Order Package 2CR was not clearly distinguishable from the dealer listing's prose (the package description explicitly adds 'heated 2nd-row seats' and ventilated fronts, implying heated FRONT seats may be standard separately, which is how this is recorded -- but this inference is not independently confirmed on jeep.com itself, since jeep.com's own Build & Price tool is a JS SPA that WebFetch could not render for a full trim-specific options breakdown despite multiple attempts). (4) The 'Grand Cherokee L' (3-row, extended-wheelbase) also offers its own Limited Reserve trim as a separate model line (seen in several of the dealer-inventory search results) -- this row covers only the standard 2-row Grand Cherokee per the task's literal naming, and the 3-row L variant is out of scope/not researched here. (5) MyFlexCare Service Plan ($225, seen on the McGovern listing) is a dealer-sold service contract, not a vehicle equipment option, so it is deliberately excluded from package_definitions.
